decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that extends our established Christmas range and visibly supports our announced blend of traditional woodcraft with technology, we would continue it and treat any weak early sales as temporary rather than abandon the investment after one season.

The nativity stable fits our core handcrafted seasonal business, has already been publicly introduced, and after only one year management would be inclined to justify the resources committed by giving it more time on the market.

Because this modern incense smoker is close to our existing offer while also signaling the contemporary design direction we have announced, we would persist with it in 2024 and attribute any initial disappointment to market uptake rather than product failure.
